title: TC001-negative adjustment blocked when it would make stock go below zero
description: Login as admin (username=jose, password=Password1). GET /api/items to find an active item (use the first one). GET /api/transactions/stock-position to find its current stock at ADEL. Then POST /api/transactions/adjustments with that itemId, location='ADEL', quantity=-(currentStock + 100) (a number that exceeds available stock), reason='Damage', notes='test negative floor'. Expect 400 response with error containing 'negative stock'. Then POST a valid small negative adjustment (quantity=-1) with the same item — expect 201 success.
code:
import requests
import time

BASE_URL = "http://localhost:3002"
LOGIN_URL = f"{BASE_URL}/api/auth/login"
ITEMS_URL = f"{BASE_URL}/api/items"
STOCK_POSITION_URL = f"{BASE_URL}/api/transactions/stock-position"
ADJUSTMENTS_URL = f"{BASE_URL}/api/transactions/adjustments"

USERNAME = "jose"
PASSWORD = "Password1"
TIMEOUT = 30

def test_negative_adjustment_blocked_below_zero():
    session = requests.Session()
    # Login as admin
    login_resp = session.post(
        LOGIN_URL,
        json={"username": USERNAME, "password": PASSWORD},
        timeout=TIMEOUT
    )
    assert login_resp.status_code == 200, f"Login failed: {login_resp.text}"
    token = login_resp.json().get("token")
    assert token, "No token in login response"
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}
    time.sleep(2)

    # GET /api/items to find first active item
    items_resp = session.get(
        ITEMS_URL,
        headers=headers,
        timeout=TIMEOUT
    )
    assert items_resp.status_code == 200, f"Get items failed: {items_resp.text}"
    items = items_resp.json().get("items")
    assert items and len(items) > 0, "No items returned"
    item = items[0]
    item_id = item.get("id")
    assert isinstance(item_id, int), "Invalid item id"
    time.sleep(2)

    # GET /api/transactions/stock-position to find stock at ADEL for that item
    stock_resp = session.get(
        STOCK_POSITION_URL,
        headers=headers,
        timeout=TIMEOUT
    )
    assert stock_resp.status_code == 200, f"Get stock-position failed: {stock_resp.text}"
    positions = stock_resp.json().get("positions", [])
    adel_stock = None
    for pos in positions:
        pos_item = pos.get("item")
        if pos_item and pos_item.get("id") == item_id:
            adel_stock = pos.get("adelQty", 0)
            break
    assert adel_stock is not None, "Stock position for item not found"
    time.sleep(2)

    # POST invalid adjustment exceeding available stock: quantity = -(adel_stock + 100)
    invalid_quantity = -(adel_stock + 100)
    invalid_adj_payload = {
        "itemId": item_id,
        "location": "ADEL",
        "quantity": invalid_quantity,
        "reason": "Damage",
        "notes": "test negative floor"
    }
    invalid_adj_resp = session.post(
        ADJUSTMENTS_URL,
        headers={**headers, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
        json=invalid_adj_payload,
        timeout=TIMEOUT
    )
    # Expect 400 with error containing "negative stock"
    assert invalid_adj_resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400 for invalid adjustment, got {invalid_adj_resp.status_code}"
    invalid_error_text = invalid_adj_resp.text.lower()
    assert "negative stock" in invalid_error_text, f"Error message does not contain 'negative stock': {invalid_adj_resp.text}"
    time.sleep(2)

    # POST valid small negative adjustment with quantity = -1 on same item
    valid_adj_payload = {
        "itemId": item_id,
        "location": "ADEL",
        "quantity": -1,
        "reason": "Damage",
        "notes": "test negative floor valid adjustment"
    }
    valid_adj_resp = session.post(
        ADJUSTMENTS_URL,
        headers={**headers, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
        json=valid_adj_payload,
        timeout=TIMEOUT
    )
    assert valid_adj_resp.status_code == 201, f"Valid adjustment failed: {valid_adj_resp.status_code} {valid_adj_resp.text}"
    resp_json = valid_adj_resp.json()
    assert "transaction" in resp_json, "Response JSON missing 'transaction'"
    transaction = resp_json["transaction"]
    assert transaction.get("itemId") == item_id, "Returned transaction itemId mismatch"
    assert transaction.get("quantity") == -1, "Returned transaction quantity mismatch"

test_negative_adjustment_blocked_below_zero()

title: TC002-Cycle Count reason rejected on manual adjustments
description: Login as admin (username=jose, password=Password1). GET /api/items to find an active item. POST /api/transactions/adjustments with that itemId, location='ADEL', quantity=-1, reason='Cycle Count', notes='test'. Expect 400 response with validation error indicating 'Cycle Count' is not a valid reason. Valid reasons are: Damage, Shrinkage, Correction, Other.
code:
import requests
import time

BASE_URL = "http://localhost:3002"
LOGIN_ENDPOINT = "/api/auth/login"
ITEMS_ENDPOINT = "/api/items"
ADJUSTMENTS_ENDPOINT = "/api/transactions/adjustments"
TIMEOUT = 30

def test_cycle_count_reason_rejected_on_manual_adjustments():
    # Step 1: Login as admin
    login_payload = {"username": "jose", "password": "Password1"}
    login_resp = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}{LOGIN_ENDPOINT}", json=login_payload, timeout=TIMEOUT)
    assert login_resp.status_code == 200, f"Login failed: {login_resp.text}"
    token = login_resp.json().get("token")
    assert token, "No token received on login"
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}

    time.sleep(2)

    # Step 2: Get an active item
    items_resp = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}{ITEMS_ENDPOINT}", headers=headers, timeout=TIMEOUT)
    assert items_resp.status_code == 200, f"Failed to get items: {items_resp.text}"
    items = items_resp.json().get("items")
    assert items and isinstance(items, list), "Items list missing or invalid"
    item = items[0]
    item_id = item.get("id")
    assert item_id is not None, "Item missing 'id'"

    time.sleep(2)

    # Step 3: POST adjustment with reason='Cycle Count' (invalid reason)
    adjustment_payload = {
        "itemId": item_id,
        "location": "ADEL",
        "quantity": -1,
        "reason": "Cycle Count",
        "notes": "test"
    }
    adj_resp = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}{ADJUSTMENTS_ENDPOINT}", headers=headers, json=adjustment_payload, timeout=TIMEOUT)

    # Expect 400 validation error about invalid reason
    assert adj_resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {adj_resp.status_code}: {adj_resp.text}"
    resp_json = adj_resp.json()
    error_text = str(resp_json).lower()
    assert "cycle count" in error_text or "validation" in error_text or "reason" in error_text, f"Response did not mention invalid reason: {adj_resp.text}"
    # Also confirm message indicates valid reasons
    valid_reasons_msgs = ["damage", "shrinkage", "correction", "other"]
    assert any(reason in error_text for reason in valid_reasons_msgs), f"Response does not list valid reasons: {adj_resp.text}"

test_cycle_count_reason_rejected_on_manual_adjustments()

title: TC003-deactivating item with positive stock is blocked
description: Login as admin (username=jose, password=Password1). GET /api/items to find an active item. GET /api/transactions/stock-position to confirm it has stock > 0 at some location. Then PATCH /api/items/:id/status with body {isActive: false}. Expect 400 response with error containing 'Cannot deactivate item with' and 'units on hand'.
code:
import requests
import time

BASE_URL = "http://localhost:3002"
TIMEOUT = 30

def test_TC003_deactivating_item_with_positive_stock_is_blocked():
    session = requests.Session()
    try:
        # Step 1: Login as admin
        login_resp = session.post(
            f"{BASE_URL}/api/auth/login",
            json={"username": "jose", "password": "Password1"},
            timeout=TIMEOUT,
        )
        assert login_resp.status_code == 200, f"Login failed: {login_resp.text}"
        token = login_resp.json().get("token")
        assert token, "No token received on login"
        headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}
        time.sleep(2)

        # Step 2: GET /api/items to find an active item (default returns active items)
        items_resp = session.get(f"{BASE_URL}/api/items", headers=headers, timeout=TIMEOUT)
        assert items_resp.status_code == 200, f"Failed to get items: {items_resp.text}"
        items = items_resp.json().get("items", [])
        assert len(items) > 0, "No active items found"
        item_id = None
        for item in items:
            if item.get("id") and item.get("isActive", True):
                item_id = item["id"]
                break
        assert item_id is not None, "No active item found with valid id"
        time.sleep(2)

        # Step 3: GET /api/transactions/stock-position to find stock of that item >0 at any location
        stock_resp = session.get(f"{BASE_URL}/api/transactions/stock-position", headers=headers, timeout=TIMEOUT)
        assert stock_resp.status_code == 200, f"Failed to get stock positions: {stock_resp.text}"
        positions = stock_resp.json().get("positions", [])
        # Find the stock position entry for the item with stock > 0 in any location
        pos_for_item = None
        for pos in positions:
            itm = pos.get("item")
            if itm and itm.get("id") == item_id:
                adel_qty = pos.get("adelQty", 0)
                calhoun_qty = pos.get("calhounQty", 0)
                if adel_qty > 0 or calhoun_qty > 0:
                    pos_for_item = pos
                    break
        assert pos_for_item is not None, "No stock position with stock > 0 found for the selected item"
        time.sleep(2)

        # Step 4: PATCH /api/items/:id/status with {isActive:false}, expect 400 with error containing expected messages
        patch_resp = session.patch(
            f"{BASE_URL}/api/items/{item_id}/status",
            headers={**headers, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
            json={"isActive": False},
            timeout=TIMEOUT,
        )
        assert patch_resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {patch_resp.status_code} - {patch_resp.text}"
        error_text = patch_resp.text.lower()
        assert "cannot deactivate item with" in error_text, f"Error message missing expected text 'Cannot deactivate item with': {patch_resp.text}"
        assert "units on hand" in error_text, f"Error message missing expected text 'units on hand': {patch_resp.text}"

    finally:
        session.close()

test_TC003_deactivating_item_with_positive_stock_is_blocked()

title: TC004-deactivating item with zero stock succeeds
description: Login as admin (username=jose, password=Password1). POST /api/items to create a new test item with body {itemCode:'TEST-DEACT-001', description:'Test Deactivation Item', category:'Test', unitOfMeasure:'EA'}. This item has zero stock (no transactions). Then PATCH /api/items/:id/status with body {isActive: false}. Expect 200 success. Then PATCH again with {isActive: true} to reactivate, expect 200.
code:
import requests
import time

BASE_URL = "http://localhost:3002"
ADMIN_USERNAME = "jose"
ADMIN_PASSWORD = "Password1"
TIMEOUT = 30
DELAY = 2


def test_tc004_deactivating_item_with_zero_stock_succeeds():
    session = requests.Session()

    # Login as admin
    login_resp = session.post(
        f"{BASE_URL}/api/auth/login",
        json={"username": ADMIN_USERNAME, "password": ADMIN_PASSWORD},
        timeout=TIMEOUT,
    )
    assert login_resp.status_code == 200, f"Login failed: {login_resp.text}"
    token = login_resp.json().get("token")
    assert token, "No token received on login"
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}
    time.sleep(DELAY)

    item_id = None
    try:
        # Create new test item with zero stock (no transactions)
        create_body = {
            "itemCode": "TEST-DEACT-001",
            "description": "Test Deactivation Item",
            "category": "Test",
            "unitOfMeasure": "EA"
        }
        create_resp = session.post(
            f"{BASE_URL}/api/items",
            json=create_body,
            headers=headers,
            timeout=TIMEOUT,
        )
        assert create_resp.status_code == 201, f"Create item failed: {create_resp.text}"
        created_item = create_resp.json().get("item")
        assert created_item and "id" in created_item, "Created item missing id"
        item_id = created_item["id"]
        time.sleep(DELAY)

        # PATCH /api/items/:id/status with {isActive: false} to deactivate
        patch_deactivate_resp = session.patch(
            f"{BASE_URL}/api/items/{item_id}/status",
            json={"isActive": False},
            headers=headers,
            timeout=TIMEOUT,
        )
        assert patch_deactivate_resp.status_code == 200, f"Deactivate item failed: {patch_deactivate_resp.text}"
        item_after_deactivate = patch_deactivate_resp.json().get("item")
        assert item_after_deactivate and item_after_deactivate.get("isActive") is False, "Item not deactivated properly"
        time.sleep(DELAY)

        # PATCH again with {isActive: true} to reactivate
        patch_reactivate_resp = session.patch(
            f"{BASE_URL}/api/items/{item_id}/status",
            json={"isActive": True},
            headers=headers,
            timeout=TIMEOUT,
        )
        assert patch_reactivate_resp.status_code == 200, f"Reactivate item failed: {patch_reactivate_resp.text}"
        item_after_reactivate = patch_reactivate_resp.json().get("item")
        assert item_after_reactivate and item_after_reactivate.get("isActive") is True, "Item not reactivated properly"
        time.sleep(DELAY)

    finally:
        # Cleanup: Deactivate the created test item to soft-delete it
        if item_id is not None:
            try:
                session.patch(
                    f"{BASE_URL}/api/items/{item_id}/status",
                    json={"isActive": False},
                    headers=headers,
                    timeout=TIMEOUT,
                )
            except Exception:
                pass

title: TC005-transfer uses serializable transaction to prevent race condition
description: Login as admin (username=jose, password=Password1). GET /api/items to find an active item. GET /api/transactions/stock-position to find its stock at ADEL. POST /api/transactions/transfers with that itemId, fromLocation='ADEL', toLocation='CALHOUN', quantity=(currentStock + 100) — exceeding available. Expect 400 with error containing 'Insufficient stock'. Then POST a valid transfer with quantity=1 — expect 201 success with outbound and inbound transactions.
code:
import requests
import time

BASE_URL = "http://localhost:3002"
TIMEOUT = 30

def test_transfer_uses_serializable_transaction_to_prevent_race_condition():
    # Login as admin
    login_url = f"{BASE_URL}/api/auth/login"
    login_payload = {"username": "jose", "password": "Password1"}
    try:
        login_resp = requests.post(login_url, json=login_payload, timeout=TIMEOUT)
        assert login_resp.status_code == 200, f"Login failed: {login_resp.text}"
        token = login_resp.json().get("token")
        assert token, "No token received on login"
    except Exception as e:
        assert False, f"Login request failed: {e}"
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}
    time.sleep(2)

    # Get active items (GET /api/items)
    items_url = f"{BASE_URL}/api/items"
    try:
        items_resp = requests.get(items_url, headers=headers, timeout=TIMEOUT)
        assert items_resp.status_code == 200, f"Failed getting items: {items_resp.text}"
        items = items_resp.json().get("items")
        assert items and len(items) > 0, "No items found"
        item = items[0]
        itemId = item.get("id")
        assert itemId is not None, "Item id missing"
    except Exception as e:
        assert False, f"Get items request failed: {e}"
    time.sleep(2)

    # Get stock positions (GET /api/transactions/stock-position)
    stock_pos_url = f"{BASE_URL}/api/transactions/stock-position"
    try:
        stock_resp = requests.get(stock_pos_url, headers=headers, timeout=TIMEOUT)
        assert stock_resp.status_code == 200, f"Failed getting stock positions: {stock_resp.text}"
        positions = stock_resp.json().get("positions", [])
        # Find the position for our itemId
        stock_position = next((pos for pos in positions if pos.get("item", {}).get("id") == itemId), None)
        assert stock_position is not None, f"Stock position for itemId {itemId} not found"
        adel_stock = stock_position.get("adelQty")
        assert adel_stock is not None, "adelQty missing in stock position"
        # adelQty can be 0 or positive; accept either
    except Exception as e:
        assert False, f"Get stock position request failed: {e}"
    time.sleep(2)

    # POST /api/transactions/transfers - attempt transfer with quantity exceeding available (adel_stock + 100)
    transfer_url = f"{BASE_URL}/api/transactions/transfers"
    invalid_quantity = adel_stock + 100 if adel_stock is not None else 100
    invalid_transfer_payload = {
        "itemId": itemId,
        "fromLocation": "ADEL",
        "toLocation": "CALHOUN",
        "quantity": invalid_quantity
    }
    try:
        invalid_resp = requests.post(transfer_url, headers=headers, json=invalid_transfer_payload, timeout=TIMEOUT)
        assert invalid_resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400 for insufficient stock, got {invalid_resp.status_code}"
        # Error message contains 'Insufficient stock'
        error_msg = invalid_resp.text.lower()
        assert "insufficient stock" in error_msg, f"Expected error containing 'Insufficient stock', got: {invalid_resp.text}"
    except Exception as e:
        assert False, f"Invalid transfer request failed: {e}"
    time.sleep(2)

    # POST valid transfer with quantity=1
    valid_transfer_payload = {
        "itemId": itemId,
        "fromLocation": "ADEL",
        "toLocation": "CALHOUN",
        "quantity": 1
    }

    try:
        valid_resp = requests.post(transfer_url, headers=headers, json=valid_transfer_payload, timeout=TIMEOUT)
        assert valid_resp.status_code == 201, f"Valid transfer failed: {valid_resp.status_code} {valid_resp.text}"
        json_resp = valid_resp.json()
        transfer_data = json_resp.get("transfer")
        assert transfer_data is not None, "No transfer data in response"
        outbound = transfer_data.get("outbound")
        inbound = transfer_data.get("inbound")
        assert outbound and inbound, "Both outbound and inbound transactions must be present"
        # outbound quantity should be negative and equal to -1
        assert isinstance(outbound.get("quantity"), (int, float)) and outbound.get("quantity") == -1, \
            f"Outbound quantity should be -1 but got {outbound.get('quantity')}"
        # inbound quantity should be positive and equal to 1
        assert isinstance(inbound.get("quantity"), (int, float)) and inbound.get("quantity") == 1, \
            f"Inbound quantity should be 1 but got {inbound.get('quantity')}"
        # itemId should match
        assert outbound.get("itemId") == itemId, "Outbound itemId mismatch"
        assert inbound.get("itemId") == itemId, "Inbound itemId mismatch"
        # fromLocation and toLocation check (outbound from ADEL to CALHOUN, inbound vice versa)
        assert outbound.get("location") == "ADEL", f"Outbound location should be ADEL but got {outbound.get('location')}"
        assert inbound.get("location") == "CALHOUN", f"Inbound location should be CALHOUN but got {inbound.get('location')}"
    except Exception as e:
        assert False, f"Valid transfer request failed: {e}"

test_transfer_uses_serializable_transaction_to_prevent_race_condition()

title: TC006-kitting with retired BOM is rejected
description: Login as admin (username=jose, password=Password1). GET /api/boms to find an active BOM. Note its id and components. PATCH /api/boms/:id/status with body {status:'RETIRED'} to retire it. Then POST /api/production/kit with that bomId, the correct finishedGoodId (GET /api/boms/:id to find it), location='ADEL', quantityProduced=1, and the correct components array. Expect 400 with error containing 'RETIRED' and 'Only ACTIVE BOMs'. Finally, PATCH /api/boms/:id/status with {status:'ACTIVE'} to restore it.
code:
import requests
import time

BASE_URL = "http://localhost:3002"
ADMIN_CREDENTIALS = {"username": "jose", "password": "Password1"}
TIMEOUT = 30  # seconds


def test_tc006_kitting_with_retired_bom_rejected():
    session = requests.Session()

    # Login as admin to get token
    login_resp = session.post(
        f"{BASE_URL}/api/auth/login",
        json=ADMIN_CREDENTIALS,
        timeout=TIMEOUT,
    )
    assert login_resp.status_code == 200, f"Login failed: {login_resp.text}"
    token = login_resp.json().get("token")
    assert token, "Token not found in login response"
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}
    time.sleep(2)

    # Get list of BOMs to find an ACTIVE BOM with components
    boms_resp = session.get(f"{BASE_URL}/api/boms?status=ACTIVE", headers=headers, timeout=TIMEOUT)
    assert boms_resp.status_code == 200, f"Failed to list BOMs: {boms_resp.text}"
    boms = boms_resp.json().get("boms")
    assert boms and isinstance(boms, list), "No BOMs found or invalid response"

    active_bom = None
    for bom in boms:
        # We need to get BOM detail to check components
        bom_id = bom.get("id") or bom.get("bomId") or bom.get("bom") and bom.get("bom").get("id")
        if not bom_id:
            continue
        time.sleep(2)
        bom_detail_resp = session.get(f"{BASE_URL}/api/boms/{bom_id}", headers=headers, timeout=TIMEOUT)
        if bom_detail_resp.status_code != 200:
            continue
        bom_detail = bom_detail_resp.json().get("bom")
        if not bom_detail:
            continue
        components = bom_detail.get("lines") or bom_detail.get("components") or []
        if components and len(components) > 0:
            active_bom = bom_detail
            break

    assert active_bom is not None, "No ACTIVE BOM with components found"
    bom_id = active_bom["id"]
    finished_good_id = active_bom.get("finishedGoodId")
    assert finished_good_id is not None, "finishedGoodId missing in BOM detail"
    components = [
        {"itemId": comp.get("itemId") or comp.get("item") and comp.get("item").get("id"), "quantityPer": comp.get("quantityPer")}
        for comp in active_bom.get("lines", [])
    ]
    # Filter out any components with missing data
    components = [c for c in components if c["itemId"] is not None and c["quantityPer"] is not None]
    assert components, "BOM components missing itemId or quantityPer"

    # Retire the BOM
    retire_resp = session.patch(
        f"{BASE_URL}/api/boms/{bom_id}/status",
        headers=headers,
        json={"status": "RETIRED"},
        timeout=TIMEOUT,
    )
    assert retire_resp.status_code == 200, f"Failed to retire BOM: {retire_resp.text}"
    time.sleep(2)

    try:
        # Attempt kitting with the retired BOM
        kit_payload = {
            "bomId": bom_id,
            "finishedGoodId": finished_good_id,
            "location": "ADEL",
            "quantityProduced": 1,
            "components": components,
        }
        kit_resp = session.post(
            f"{BASE_URL}/api/production/kit",
            headers={**headers, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
            json=kit_payload,
            timeout=TIMEOUT,
        )
        assert kit_resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400 for retired BOM kitting, got {kit_resp.status_code}: {kit_resp.text}"
        error_text = kit_resp.text.upper()
        assert "RETIRED" in error_text and "ONLY ACTIVE BOMS" in error_text, f"Error message does not mention 'RETIRED' and 'Only ACTIVE BOMs': {kit_resp.text}"
    finally:
        # Restore BOM status back to ACTIVE regardless of test success/failure
        time.sleep(2)
        restore_resp = session.patch(
            f"{BASE_URL}/api/boms/{bom_id}/status",
            headers=headers,
            json={"status": "ACTIVE"},
            timeout=TIMEOUT,
        )
        assert restore_resp.status_code == 200, f"Failed to restore BOM to ACTIVE: {restore_resp.text}"

    session.close()


test_tc006_kitting_with_retired_bom_rejected()
